title: 宝塚記念の後に・Weave a Story

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion revels in the Takarazuka Kinen, and her performance stirs the hearts of everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy compares Fine Motion to the main character of a story. She realizes that as long as her story continues in everyone's hearts, she has nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion decides that her next race will be the Sapporo Kinen. And I know that a certain other notable Umamusume is going to be running there as well!
